title: Reminders of Him
author: Colleen Hoover
summary: After years in prison for a tragic mistake, Kenna returns to the small town where she grew up, hoping to meet the young daughter she has never known, while a local bar owner with his own ties to the past gets in the way.
readIf: you want a moving romance about grief, forgiveness and second chances.
skipIf: you don't want a story where the heroine is shunned and the pain is front and centre.

pairings.reason: Hoover's best-known novel, also built around hard choices and a protagonist finding her footing.
Another moving novel about a child, a secret and a moral decision with no easy answer.
Another Hoover family-centred story of grief and betrayal with a hopeful ending.
